comparison_method: One matched synthetic multi-successor task was supplied to the transition preflight once per successor and to the Pareto summary once across all candidates. Output coverage and CLI elapsed time were recorded; no real candidate system ran.

compared_tools.declared_scope: Summarizes paired candidate outcomes and one caller-declared resource metric into pass-rate, cost, dominated, and frontier results.
compared_tools.difference: It does not bind a frozen predecessor-successor transition, evaluator drift, held-out replay, permission delta, rollback target, or later-round R&D gain.

compared_tools.declared_scope: Checks declared producer and consumer text patterns and field matches from caller-provided source excerpts.
compared_tools.difference: It checks a static producer-consumer relation and does not compare predecessor-successor improvement evidence.

compared_tools.declared_scope: Reviews caller-selected paragraph order and declared cognitive migration while preserving source text boundaries.
compared_tools.difference: Its input and output concern revision structure, not system-transition measurements, evaluator binding, cost, failures, authority, or rollback.

same_task_trials.measured_cost: Local Python CLI elapsed time only; 30 process invocations per input shape, including interpreter startup; no calibrated runtime or operating-cost estimate.
same_task_trials.matched_quality_results: Predecessor A passed 2/3; B passed 2/3 at 8 declared work units/case; C passed 3/3 at 11 units/case. Pareto reported B and C on the observed frontier; transition reviews returned REVIEW_REQUIRED for A→B and A→C.

decision.coexistence_basis: On the one synthetic task, Pareto uniquely summarized the multi-successor pass-rate/resource frontier; transition preflight uniquely reported per-successor evaluation binding, failure/cost guardrails, authority scope, rollback binding, and next-round R&D status. This demonstrates complementary declared output coverage only. Real-task utility, correctness, reliability, generalization, and cost remain unknown; do not replace or retire any tool.

low_cost_follow_up.proposal: Executed the planned low-cost matched synthetic comparison: one frozen A/B/C packet, two per-successor transition preflights, and one multi-candidate Pareto summary; compared output coverage, invocation count, and local CLI elapsed time.

claim_ceiling: The comparison establishes declared contract differences only; it does not establish superior quality, lower cost, reliability, or replacement value.
